description: Verified, sourced historical race runs available before a target race. No synthetic race comments or inferred telemetry. Add evidence only where usage is permitted.
licensing: Confirm rights to store and process any provider data; retain short factual tags rather than verbatim copyright-protected report text.

fieldGuide.sourceUrl: Direct source to historical race result or Steward report
fieldGuide.sourceCheckedAt: Date/time note recorded; MUST precede any target prediction date
fieldGuide.comment: Short summary of factually verified in-running observation (paraphrase where needed)
fieldGuide.officialRating: Official mark at time of race; not today's updated OR
fieldGuide.performanceFigure: Official contemporary performance figure, if verified
fieldGuide.sectionals: Only rights-cleared furlong times; never synthetic
